findings.title: Service Bound to All Interfaces (0.0.0.0:8081)
findings.details: Port 8081 (python3 (PID 18999)) accepts connections from all local network interfaces (0.0.0.0) instead of binding to loopback (127.0.0.1) or routing through Cloudflare Zero Trust.
findings.remediation: Bind service to 127.0.0.1 and tunnel externally via Cloudflare Tunnel.

findings.title: Missing Pre-Push Secret Hook: Chamunda RE Enterprise & Aradhya CEO
findings.details: Repository Chamunda RE Enterprise & Aradhya CEO lacks an active pre-push secret blocking hook. Pushes to public GitHub can accidentally leak credentials.
findings.remediation: Install executable .git/hooks/pre-push script to intercept secret leaks prior to git push.

findings.title: Unrestricted GitHub Actions Permissions in ci.yml (Chamunda RE Enterprise & Aradhya CEO)
findings.details: Workflow ci.yml executes on pull_request without explicit 'permissions: contents: read' least-privilege block.
findings.remediation: Add 'permissions: contents: read' to restrict default write permissions for workflow GITHUB_TOKEN.

findings.title: Dependabot Not Configured: Chamunda RE Enterprise & Aradhya CEO
findings.details: Repository Chamunda RE Enterprise & Aradhya CEO does not have .github/dependabot.yml for automated dependency vulnerability patching.
findings.remediation: Add .github/dependabot.yml to enable weekly dependency audits.
